limits: Twelve deliberately selected prefixes from four longest responses are not a random population sample.
Observed pre-update references use current=old; logit movement with SD0.2 is synthetic sensitivity, not a measured learning update.
Eight draws use actual full-vocabulary q on CPU; this does not qualify cheap V2 capture.
Native filtering support and q are recaptured together; production PPO/TIS/KL/entropy support normalization remains absent.
HTTP comparison uses one short arithmetic prompt, exact rendered prefixes and fixed seeds; it does not implement native chat tools, continuation, reasoning, R3 or version contracts.
Long geometry uses repeated actual source tokens and balanced controlled expert routes, not a natural 100K rollout.
Cost comparison is separately version12; version15 has one live warmup batch and no matched-cost repeats.
